pages.text:
Golf
SportWagen
Go places. Do things. Get versatile. The Golf SportWagen is paving
a new path for those who seek adventure across country or across
town. With a turbocharged engine and impressive cargo space, it
has room for plenty of excitement and friends. And it possesses the
versatility, amenities, and style you’d expect from a Volkswagen.
It’s the sportier utility vehicle.
